name: FinNexus
rootCause: According to an official statement from on-chain options protocol FinNexus, part of FinNexus’ hardware has been attacked by malware, and an unknown hacker infiltrated the FinNexus system and managed to recover the private key of the ownership of the FNX token contract. FNX was minted, transferred or sold in large numbers in a short period of time, involving more than 300 million FNX tokens (about 7 million US dollars) in BSC and Ethereum.

descriptions.text: According to an official statement from on-chain options protocol FinNexus, part of FinNexus’ hardware has been attacked by malware, and an unknown hacker infiltrated the FinNexus system and managed to recover the private key of the ownership of the FNX token contract. FNX was minted, transferred or sold in large numbers in a short period of time, involving more than 300 million FNX tokens (about 7 million US dollars) in BSC and Ethereum.

FinNexus disclosed a compromise of the FNX token administrator key on 2021-05-17 after an attacker gained control of token ownership permissions on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Public reporting indicates the attacker minted hundreds of millions of FNX tokens and sold them into market liquidity, causing the token price to collapse and producing reported losses of roughly $7 million. Available evidence indicates that the attacker obtained the private key or equivalent administrative authority controlling the FNX token contracts.
